role.title: Software Engineering LMTS
bodyArray: Promoted to Lead Member of Technical Staff, taking on expanded technical leadership and ownership across the team.

role.title: Software Engineering SMTS
bodyArray: Served as Scrum Lead, facilitating sprint ceremonies, maintaining delivery cadence, and driving cross-functional alignment between engineering, product, and stakeholders.
Enhanced gateway scalability by implementing an SQS-based queueing system, reducing throughput bottlenecks under high load.
Refactored the Golang gateway codebase to improve readability, maintainability, and unit test coverage.
Introduced LocalStack for AWS service emulation, enabling reliable integration testing in both local Docker environments and CI/CD pipelines.
Provided cross-functional engineering, administration, and DevOps support across multiple applications using Kubernetes, AWS, Jenkins, and Splunk.

role.title: Software Engineering MTS
bodyArray: Designed and delivered a Salesforce Managed Package enabling end-users to interact with routing engine APIs natively within the Salesforce UI.
Extended an existing managed package to surface routing problem visualizations and key performance metrics within an embedded Salesforce map interface.
Provided ongoing administration and infrastructure support across multiple internal applications and services.

role.title: Senior Technical Consultant
bodyArray: Partnered with clients undergoing digital transformation to architect tailored Salesforce solutions aligned with business requirements and existing infrastructure.
Designed, developed, tested, and delivered multiple custom Salesforce features and configurations, driving measurable improvements to client workflows.

role.title: Sr. Services Developer
bodyArray: Engaged with clients to design and build custom Salesforce solutions, including a full-featured vehicle routing solution powered by the MapAnything Routing Engine.
Architected and delivered the end-to-end routing solution with a Visualforce/JavaScript front end styled with the Lightning Design System and an Apex/Flow back end.
Leveraged custom fields, objects, pages, permission sets, and record types to achieve seamless native integration within the Salesforce platform.
Delivered the solution on time, receiving strong client commendation for its intuitive design and routing capabilities, producing significant operational time and cost savings.
Migrated 30+ custom MapAnything code solutions to Salesforce Maps, completing the transition on time and within budget.

role.title: Sr. Services Developer
bodyArray: Led development and maintenance of MapAnything Live, a real-time vehicle asset tracking solution integrated with Salesforce, delivering new features and ensuring consistent platform performance.
Drove architectural decision-making and collaborated with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements, delivering training and support that accelerated technology adoption.
Maintained and upgraded a portfolio of custom client solutions, proactively addressing technical debt and ensuring long-term reliability.
Developed bespoke Salesforce solutions for clients using Apex, SOQL, Visualforce, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

role.title: Services Developer
bodyArray: Developed custom Salesforce solutions for clients across the full software development lifecycle — from requirements gathering and implementation through testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance — with a focus on scalability and long-term maintainability.
Contributed to architectural decision-making and stakeholder collaboration, providing training and support to ensure effective adoption of delivered solutions.
Consistently delivered projects on time and within budget, earning positive client feedback for translating complex business requirements into high-quality, maintainable technical solutions.

role.title: Reporting Data Analyst
bodyArray: Developed, maintained, and optimized enterprise reports in Tableau and SSRS while managing the reporting data warehouse and building ETL workflows in SAP Data Services Designer.
Reduced ETL processing time by 54% — from a minimum of 24 hours to an average of 11 hours — by optimizing nightly job routines.
Championed the adoption of SSRS within the reporting environment, enabling more granular, role-appropriate data access for business users.
Contributed to the design and build of an internal SharePoint site centralizing corporate reporting resources.

role.title: Technology Analyst
bodyArray: Facilitated requirements gathering across business units, documenting data needs and translating them into actionable report specifications.
Developed SSRS and SQL-based reports in close collaboration with stakeholders, delivering actionable insights that supported data-driven decision-making.
Supported a migration to the ViewPoint platform by recreating existing SSRS reports, ensuring no disruption to reporting capabilities for stakeholders.

role.title: Tech Intern — Territory Analytics
bodyArray: Enhanced an internal C# and SQL Server application used daily by the territory analytics team, improving performance, efficiency, and the address validation workflow; produced comprehensive documentation and architecture diagrams.
Automated ArcGIS workflows using Python batch scripts, improving nightly processing routines and enabling full automation of monthly jobs.
Developed SSRS reports and ad hoc SQL queries using stored procedures to support territory analytics operations.
